text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing through the shopping
district on the way back from shopping with
K.S.Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Shopper (Child)
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Daddy! I wanna spin the raffle wheel!
Gimme that ticket from earlier! Pleeease!"

text_block_list.name: Shopper (Father)
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I'll give it to you.
Excuse me, mister, one try, please.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Coming right up!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's completely empty, huh...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, the nurses brought them in
for in-hospital recreation activities, you see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Was it a bingo tournament? The event itself was a blast, but both everyone else and I were totally hooked on spinning the raffle wheel...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After the recreation was over,
we all took turns spinning it around.
...Brings back memories.
choice_data_list: ...Were you able to pull off the miracle properly at that time too?
...Did you manage to pull off the miracle properly back then too?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

I pressed further with the bewildered K.S. Miracle.
Knowing her tendency to always put herself second—
choice_data_list: Didn't you just end up giving it up to everyone else?
Didn't you just end up giving it up to everyone else?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No... How was it again?
I completely forgot... Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome home... Wait, whoa!
What's the deal with that giant daruma...?
choice_data_list: I suddenly just really wanted it! ...More importantly, look at this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! A lottery ticket...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, honestly...
...You really are amazing, Trainer.
To even show kindness to the old me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... and thank you.
I'll go give it a try, just once.
choice_data_list: Go give it a big spin!

text_block_list.text:
While holding the giant Daruma doll—honestly at a loss for where to put it—I watch over warmly.
K.S.Miracle turns the raffle wheel crank.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! I did it...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Would this work as a thank-you...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please, make sure to take your time and relax.
choice_data_list: No, you're the one who earned it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm completely satisfied
just having been allowed to spin the wheel."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Besides, look at that banner over there. It says 'An exquisite moment of relaxation'...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who works the hardest, Trainer-san,
so I want you to go get some rest and relaxation.
choice_data_list: No, no, you're the one working so hard
No, no, you're the one working so hard

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't an argument after that, exactly...
but they kept playfully going back and forth on who worked harder
and who deserved to be pampered more—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...We're back at the academy already, huh. Ahaha..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then, would you like to go to the hot springs together?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Right now we've got races like the Takamatsunomiya Kinen coming up, so... maybe when we have a bit more time to relax."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no.
...I'm really looking forward to our hot springs trip.

I was a little curious about what she had started to say
before stopping herself, but decided not to press her,
and we parted ways in front of the school gates for the day...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Knowing Trainer, they'd probably just
reply with, 'I'll do my best so you can rest, Miracle,'
so... I didn't say it, but...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best.
To make sure this trip lets you get plenty of rest."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Alright—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Wow, it's so thick and looks delicious...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It was fun grinding it.
Thank you very much, Trainer.
Here, please have some salisbury steak.
choice_data_list: No, no, you should definitely eat it!
No, no, you should be the one to eat it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, no, but this is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you two!
This is our shopping district's pride and joy, ya know?
Rather than holding back for each other, just dig in and enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
How about this! Why don't you two split it?
Good friends ought to share and eat together!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Half each...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then... Trainer.
Let's eat together next time.
...In the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Still, if I'm taking half of it—

K.S. Miracle, who had been muttering something to herself,
later on, on the very day
we were about to eat those hamburg steaks—
To my surprise, she made an omelet for me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're sharing half of your delicious hamburg steak with me,
so I wanted to at least offer something in return, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still... ahaha, sorry.
When it comes to cooking, I'm... yeah, not so great."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My mothers taught me a few things when I was home...
but I spent far more time in the hospital,
so I don't have much experience.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's more like 'I can barely manage it.'
Even this time, the shape didn't turn out very pretty."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Giving it to you when you're such a good cook yourself, Trainer... feels a bit—well, pretty intimidating, haha.

K.S. Miracle had said as much, but...
The omelet itself had a mild, gentle seasoning that
paired wonderfully with the richly flavored hamburg steakâ

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really?
What a relief...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, but it's a bit frustrating, so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If there's a next time, I'll...
I'll try even harder.
I'll polish my skills... as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what a massive amount...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to spin the raffle wheel was enough for me,
so I was planning to give the prize to you, Trainer, but... umm.
choice_data_list: There's no way I can use all this up...!

text_block_list.text: And so, what suddenly came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Gather 'round, everyone! Kay-chan and her friends
brought us loooots of carrots today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text:
"Yay! We did it, we did it!!"
"Kay-chan, Trainer-san, thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Human Children
text_block_list.text:
"Carrots, huh~... I'm not that into them~..."
"Yeah, me neither. Let's give them to the Umamusume girls~."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's alright. We're having it turned into
sweet jelly right now so every single one of them
can enjoy eating it.

text_block_list.name: Human Children
text_block_list.text:
"Jelly?! For real?!"
"Yay! Then I'm eating it~!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!
And so, we played plenty with the children while waiting for the jelly to set—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "So yummy~!!"

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan, this is super tasty!
Here, have a bite!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Blue Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Ah, have some of mine, mine too!
Eat as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thank you.
Don't worry about me though, you all go ahead and eat plenty.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Blue Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
...K-chan, not hungry?
Are you feeling sick?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all!
I'm just really full right now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because right before coming here,
I had just eaten the carrot castella
that Trainer made for me.

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Blue Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we should be heading home soon.
See you all later!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "See ya~!"
With that, just as I was about to follow after the departing K.S.Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Blue Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Blue Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Hey, don't take it away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan, don't take it.
...Kana-chan, Rii-chan, and Sumi-chan all promised not to hog it for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Girl
text_block_list.text: So, don't take it!

...It seemed I had just received
some rather adorable advice.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wish I could have given you a slightly better prize after all that...
I'm sorry. Here you go, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: No, I'll give it to Miracle.

text_block_list.text:
I add that I just happen to have some leftover carrots at home anyway.
Half of it is true, and the other half is to keep her from feeling bad about accepting.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
Hmm, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! I forgot the carrots~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, this sucks... What was the point of
making a shopping list if I was just gonna forget it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, I felt satisfied after making the notes
and thought, 'I totally got this!',
so it's my fault for not checking them, but still."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, going back to buy it?
What a drag~...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Miracle-chan.
And... her Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hey there.
Um... sorry, did you hear my pathetic talking to myself... out loud...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... No, uh...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I just happen to have a carrot with me...
Could it be of any help?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, truly a miracle~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you two,
please just relax and wait for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We managed to borrow the kitchen, so...
I'm gonna treat you to a massive feast
of my special carrot okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wah, yay...!
Trainer. Hishi Miracle's okonomiyaki
is super delicious, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Miracle-chan, I'd appreciate it if
you didn't raise the bar *too* high...~
Well, I do have some confidence, I guess? A little.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yeah, I think it's great to be full of confidence!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're way too refreshingly earnest...
I'm gonna end up believing you, so whoa there, whoa.
Despite Hishi Miracle's humble words, the okonomiyaki she treated me to was genuinely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, after having so much fun with it
and then getting it wrong...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to give you the prize as a thank-you gift, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You really don't have to go out of your way
to be so gentle, you know.
And so, K.S. Miracle was left feeling thoroughly downcast...
